# Upstream workflow files the fork deletes and keeps deleted (fork-follow.sh). One path per line;
# '#' starts a comment line. On every follow the plan deletes each listed file that upstream edited
# or brought back (a rebase conflict on a listed file is resolved by deleting it), and it stops red
# when this file is missing or a line is not a .github/workflows/*.yml path. The fork's sweep
# (fork-workflows.sh) disables upstream workflows only once GitHub lists them, which cannot stop the
# first run of one that someone outside the fork can start; these are such files.
#
# pull_request_target: an outside pull request starts it with main's copy and a write token.
.github/workflows/mobile-eas-preview-fork.yml
# Owner decision, 2026-11-12.
.github/workflows/desktop-macos-preview.yml
# workflow_run on a workflow named "CI": an outside pull request can add a workflow of that name.
.github/workflows/thread-transfer-report.yml
.github/workflows/mobile-fingerprint-label.yml
# issues (opened, reopened): anyone who may open an issue starts it; upstream added it in 2026-11.
.github/workflows/issue-vouch.yml
